compute_size: compute the total skeleton length of 3D body or hand joints in main order for scaling
main_to_a4: convert 20-joint body keypoints from main order to A4/OpenPose 21-joint format
main_to_a4_hand: convert 21-joint hand keypoints from main order to A4/Freiburg hand format
assemble_total_3d: assemble and scale 3D body and hand keypoints into a single concatenated array with proper alignment
assemble_total_2d: assemble and normalize 2D body and hand keypoints from crop-local to image-space coordinates
main_to_human36m: convert 20-joint body keypoints from main order to Human3.6M 17-joint format
